title: Changes to Student visa application rules (subclasses 500 and 590)
body: From 2 October 2026, changes to Student (subclass 500) and Student Guardian (subclass 590) visas affect who may apply or receive a visa while in Australia and when family members may be included. The rules do not mean that every student application is banned. Check the detailed Home Affairs guidance for your circumstances.
keywords: recent new rules reform changes update oct 2 october second 2026 international student visa subclass 500 590 guardian

title: Applying for a Student or Student Guardian visa while in Australia
body: Under the rules from 2 October 2026, most affected temporary visa holders must be outside Australia when lodging a Student or Student Guardian application and when the visa is granted. Some current Student visa holders have limited exceptions when applying for a further Student visa. The changes do not affect a current Student visa. Home Affairs lists the affected visas and exceptions.
keywords: student visa apply application lodge onshore offshore australia location grant 2 october 2026 exceptions

title: Including or adding family members to a Student visa
body: Most new Student visa applicants cannot include a partner or dependent child unless a listed exemption applies. A family member cannot be added as a subsequent entrant after the Student visa is granted; Home Affairs says there is no exemption to that later-addition rule.
keywords: student visa family partner spouse child children dependent dependant include add subsequent entrant october 2026

title: Student visa applications lodged before 2 October 2026
body: Student visa applications lodged before 2 October 2026 continue to be assessed under the rules in place when they were lodged, including applications with family members.
keywords: student visa previous before earlier old existing grandfathered lodged submitted 2 october 2026

title: Changes to the legislative framework for overseas students
body: From 2 October 2026 until 30 June 2027, the provider-transfer restriction for non-school overseas students is temporarily 12 months instead of six. School students remain subject to the first six months of their first registered school course. Check the Department of Education factsheets for exceptions.
keywords: student provider transfer change college course school non-school 12 months six months october 2026

title: Apply for a tax file number
body: Applying for a tax file number (TFN) is free. The ATO offers different application routes depending on whether you are an Australian resident, a foreign passport holder or temporary visitor, or outside Australia. Choose the route matching your circumstances on the official ATO page; do not enter your identity details in this chat.
keywords: tfn tax file number apply get obtain new free ato international student temporary visa foreign passport

title: Student visa (subclass 500)
section: Official visa page and step-by-step guide
body: Start at the official Student visa (subclass 500) page. Read its eligibility and step-by-step application guide before applying. From 2 October 2026, most Student visa applications must be lodged outside Australia; only people who meet the listed location and exemption criteria can apply in Australia. Check your location against the Home Affairs rules before you lodge.
keywords: where how apply student visa subclass 500 official application route step by step immiaccount onshore offshore location

title: Apply and manage your application
body: Home Affairs says to read the relevant visa requirements and step-by-step guide before applying. ImmiAccount is its online route to start a new visa application or continue a saved one. For Student visa subclass 500, first check the Student visa page, including where you are permitted to lodge.
keywords: where how apply student visa subclass 500 official application route immiaccount online start new application

title: Stay longer in Australia
section: Check visa expiry and conditions first
body: To stay longer in Australia after your course, you need a new visa. Whether you can apply while in Australia depends on your circumstances and any condition preventing further stay. If an onshore application is available to you, apply before your current visa expires.
keywords: graduating graduation graduate college international student in Australia what next post study after finishing course first move visa VEVO expiry conditions stay longer

title: Check visa details and conditions for visa holders
section: Check current visa details in VEVO
body: First check the expiry date, period of stay and conditions of your current visa in VEVO or your visa grant letter. VEVO shows current visa details, not the status of a new application being assessed. Use Home Affairs' service directly; this chat cannot see your visa record.
keywords: graduating graduation graduate college international student in Australia what next move post study VEVO visa expiry conditions current visa record

title: Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485)
section: Possible post-study work and study streams
body: The Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) may let eligible recent international graduates live, work and study in Australia temporarily. The Post-Higher Education Work stream is for eligible degree-level graduates; the Post-Vocational Education Work stream is for eligible associate degree, diploma or trade graduates whose qualification relates to an occupation Australia needs. Check the stream-specific Home Affairs criteria and required evidence; completing a course does not by itself establish eligibility.
keywords: graduating graduation graduate college international student in Australia what next move post study after course work temporary graduate visa subclass 485 degree vocational diploma trade qualification

title: Student visa (subclass 500)
section: Further study and other reasons to stay
body: If you want to continue studying after your current course, check whether you need a new Student visa. From 2 October 2026, most current Student visa holders must apply for a further Student visa from outside Australia unless an exemption applies. If you want to stay for another reason, Home Affairs says to apply for a new visa suited to your circumstances. Check the current application-location rules before making plans.
keywords: graduating graduation graduate college international student in Australia what next move post study further education next course new student visa subclass 500 onshore offshore work other visa options October 2026

title: Lost or stolen TFN
body: If you already have a tax file number (TFN), find it in your own ATO online services linked to myGov or in the ATO app. You can also check an ATO notice of assessment, ATO letter or income statement. Do not enter your TFN in this chat.
keywords: lost forgot forgotten misplaced find recover existing my tfn tax file number ato mygov app records

title: Create a myGov account and link it to the ATO
section: Link the ATO to your myGov account
body: To link the ATO to myGov, sign in to your own myGov account, choose View and link services, select the Australian Taxation Office and follow the identity prompts there. Do not enter sign-in or identity details in this chat.
keywords: how link connect ato australian taxation office mygov account view services identity

title: Do I need to lodge a tax return?
body: Whether you need to lodge an Australian tax return depends on your circumstances and the income year. Use the ATO's Do I need to lodge a tax return? tool for the relevant year; the ATO provides a website version and a version in ATO online services linked to myGov. This chat cannot decide your personal obligation.
keywords: where check whether need must should required lodge australian tax return tool current year

title: Check visa details and conditions for visa holders
body: Use Home Affairs' Visa Entitlement Verification Online (VEVO) to check details and conditions on a visa you currently hold, including its expiry. VEVO does not show previous visas or new applications still being assessed. Enter any passport or visa reference details only on the official VEVO service, not in this chat.
keywords: where how check conditions visa already hold held current granted vevo details rights expiry

title: After you apply online
body: If you lodged a visa application online, sign in to your own ImmiAccount to check its status under My applications summary. You can also check messages and any Actions required there. This assistant cannot access your application or decision.
keywords: how check status progress pending visa application lodged online immiaccount after apply messages actions required

title: Access your income statement
body: If your employer reports through Single Touch Payroll, view your income statement in your own ATO online services linked to myGov or in the ATO app. In myGov, open the ATO service, then Employment and Income statement. Check whether the statement is marked Tax ready before relying on it for a return. This chat cannot see your record.
keywords: where view access see find income statement work wages employment ato mygov tax ready

title: Super health check
section: Check for lost and unclaimed super
body: To look for lost or ATO-held super, sign in to your own ATO online services through myGov, choose Super, then Fund details. Lost super may still be held by a fund, while unclaimed super may be held by the ATO. This chat cannot see your accounts or balance.
keywords: how look for find search lost missing unclaimed super superannuation ato mygov fund details

title: How to track the progress of your tax return
body: After lodging a tax return, sign in to myGov, select the ATO linked service, open Manage tax returns and choose the income year to see its status. The ATO app is another route. This chat cannot see your return or predict an exact refund date.
keywords: how check progress status track tax return already lodged mygov ato manage tax returns income year refund

title: Explore visa options for visiting
section: Visa Finder for holidays and visits
body: Use the Home Affairs Visa Finder to compare possible visa options for a holiday or visit to Australia. Answer its questions about your visit, then read the official page for any visa it suggests. The finder does not decide eligibility or provide a fixed application fee.
keywords: where compare visa options holiday visit tourism australia visa finder visitor

title: You have a new passport
section: Update passport details after an application
body: If your passport changes after you lodge an online visa application, tell Home Affairs through your own ImmiAccount. Open the application, select Update details, then Change of passport details and submit the change there. The Home Affairs page explains when a separate web form is needed. Do not enter passport details in this chat.
keywords: how update change new passport details after lodging lodged visa application immiaccount travel document

title: Who needs health examinations
body: Whether a temporary visa applicant needs a health examination depends on the visa, intended stay, activities, country and circumstances. For an online Student visa application, check View health assessment in your own ImmiAccount. Home Affairs shows an Organise health examinations link there if examinations are required; this chat cannot decide which tests you need.
keywords: how know need health medical examination examinations student visa immiaccount view assessment

title: Stay longer in Australia
section: Options before a Visitor visa expires
body: A Visitor visa does not extend automatically. To stay longer in Australia you generally need to apply for a new visa; a condition on your current visa may prevent applying from inside Australia. Check your own visa conditions and Home Affairs' stay-longer guidance. This chat cannot decide your eligibility.
keywords: can stay longer australia visitor visa close expiring expires expire extend extension new visa conditions

title: Visa pricing estimator
section: Estimate a current visa application charge
body: For a current Student visa fee estimate, use the Home Affairs Visa Pricing Estimator and enter the requested application details there. The estimate can vary by circumstances and may omit other charges. This reviewed note does not store a fixed fee.
keywords: exact current fee cost price pricing charge processing time student visa subclass 500 estimator

title: Global visa processing times
body: For Student visa processing times, use Home Affairs' processing-times guide and choose the relevant visa type, stream and application date. Its figures are based on recently decided applications; they do not guarantee a decision timeframe for your application. This reviewed note does not store an exact processing time.
keywords: exact current fee processing time times student visa subclass 500 guide recently decided

title: How tax works and how much you pay
body: The ATO collects tax for the Australian Government. Most income you earn is taxable. If you work for an employer, they usually withhold tax from your pay; the amount depends on your income and circumstances. Check the ATO income tax rates or calculator linked from this official myGov page for a current estimate rather than relying on a fixed figure in this chat.
keywords: what is income tax why pay tax how tax works tax on wages salary pay rates withheld employer calculator australia

title: Tax and superannuation as a visa holder
section: Tax residency differs from visa status
body: Your residency status for Australian tax can be different from your visa or citizenship status. A visa holder can be an Australian resident for tax purposes. The amount of tax you pay depends on your circumstances, so use the ATO tax-residency guidance linked from this myGov page to assess your situation. This chat cannot determine your personal tax residency.
keywords: am i tax resident international student visa holder tax residency temporary resident citizen resident for tax purposes

title: Tax and superannuation as a visa holder
section: What superannuation is for visa holders
body: Superannuation, or super, is retirement savings that most workers in Australia receive. Employers generally pay required super contributions into a super fund account. You can check and manage your super using your own ATO online services through myGov. Eligibility and amounts depend on your work circumstances; this chat cannot see your fund or balance.
keywords: what is super superannuation how works employer contributions fund retirement visa holder international student

title: About myGov
body: myGov is an online account operated by Services Australia that provides access to linked government services in one place. You can choose which services to link, including the ATO. Some linked services send messages to a secure myGov Inbox. You can browse general information on the myGov website without signing in. This chatbot is separate from myGov and cannot access your account.
keywords: what is mygov what can mygov do account government services ato link secure inbox how does mygov work works

title: Create a myGov account
body: To create a myGov account, use the official myGov website and select Create account. You need a personal email address only you can access, or a Digital ID. The email route asks you to verify your email and set up a password and multifactor authentication. Once the account exists, you can link services such as the ATO. Enter passwords, codes and identity details only on the official myGov site, never in this chat.
keywords: how create make open set up sign up register mygov account email digital id password multifactor authentication

title: What to do at tax time
section: Lodge a tax return online through myGov
body: If you need to lodge a tax return, sign in to myGov and select the linked ATO service. In the ATO service, choose Tax, then Lodgments, then Income tax to view returns you need to lodge. First use the ATO need-to-lodge tool if you are unsure whether a return is required. This chat cannot lodge a return or access your tax account.
keywords: how where lodge file submit complete tax return online mygov ato tax lodgments income tax

title: What to do at tax time
body: If the ATO confirms you do not need to lodge a tax return, myGov says to submit a non-lodgment advice to the ATO. Sign in to myGov, select the linked ATO service, then Tax, Lodgments and Non-lodgment advice. Use the ATO need-to-lodge tool before deciding; additional Services Australia requirements may apply to your circumstances.
keywords: non lodgment non-lodgment advice do not need to lodge tax return mygov ato tax lodgments

title: Student visa (subclass 500)
section: Work limits and checking visa conditions
body: Home Affairs states that Student visa holders can generally work up to 48 hours a fortnight while their course is in session. Exceptions and different rules can apply, including for certain research degree students and when the course is not in session. You cannot work before your course starts unless an exception applies. Check your own visa grant letter or VEVO for the conditions and work rights that apply to you; this chat cannot decide your individual entitlement.
keywords: can i work working hours employment rights limit international student visa subclass 500 48 hours fortnight course session holidays vevo

title: Check visa details and conditions
section: Student visa work condition after course completion
body: Home Affairs condition 8105 limits Student visa work to 48 hours a fortnight while a course is in session. Its guidance says a course is not in session once the course listed on the Confirmation of Enrolment has been completed and the visa remains valid. The condition and any exceptions on your own visa must be checked in your grant letter or VEVO. Graduation alone does not extend a visa or establish work rights after it expires.
keywords: how many hours work after graduation graduated graduating completed course student visa 48 hours fortnight 8105 vevo conditions expiry
